name: Pharmacology and Molecular Sciences PhD

deadlines.label: Fall 2027 completed application
deadlines.note: All components received by closing date; no time published.

english.note: TOEFL/IELTS for nonnative international applicants, received by deadline. U.S. degree completed or due before matriculation waives TOEFL; no numeric minimum in program PDF. English application materials; WES approved for international transcripts. Department additionally allows English-instruction foreign degree exemption, broader than PDF; confirm acceptance. Department says no score minimum and anomalously gives competitive IELTS 4.0; no numeric threshold inferred.

applicationFee.note: 2026–2027 application fee covers up to four listed SOM PhD applications. Income waiver US citizens/PR only; military and qualifying alumni categories. Non-US applicants meeting alumni category may request with supporting evidence; no general international hardship waiver.

documents: One-page single-spaced statement: motivation, meaningful research and program fit
requirements.note: Qualified science bachelor; expected biology, inorganic/organic/physical chemistry, calculus and physics; biochemistry desirable. No adviser needed before applying. Accepted students undergo background check and provide official transcripts.

funding.note: SOM PhD support guaranteed subject to collective bargaining agreement; tuition and eligible student health benefits. Minimum $52,000 for 2026–2027, not a Fall 2027 rate.

detailsNote: Fall 2027 closing date confirmed; admission model not confirmed on opened sources.

timeline.interviews: Invitations late December/early January; virtual interviews usually early February.
